h1: Painters in Dunnellon, FL, From Historic Downtown to Rainbow Springs
heroIntro: From the historic Florida Cracker houses downtown to the newer streets near Rainbow Springs, Dunnellon homes and businesses live with river-town humidity all year, and that's what Precision Paint Experts plans every repaint around. Each job opens with a crew lead's free written estimate.

sections.h2: A painting contractor for a two-river town
body: Dunnellon is shaped by water. Two rivers run through the area, Rainbow Springs is part of the town's identity, and the moisture in the air rarely lets up, even outside the summer storm season. As painters in Dunnellon, FL, we treat paint as a moisture barrier first and a color second, because on a house this close to the water, that is what it has to be.

We drive down from Newberry, and Dunnellon sits inside the five-county territory our locally owned company has covered over 15+ years of painting. The business is licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, workers' comp extends to each painter, and those painters are on our own payroll; we never hand a Dunnellon job to a subcontractor.

sections.h2: Historic Cracker homes and the neighborhoods around them
body: The downtown historic district is known for its Florida Cracker houses: wood-framed homes with board siding, deep porches, and plenty of exposed trim. These houses need patient prep. Many carry layers of old paint that we scrape back until the edges hold, then sand smooth and spot-prime, and the porch floors, posts, and rails see harder wear than the siding ever does. We replace rotted boards rather than hiding them, and we choose breathable 100% acrylic systems that let wood siding release moisture rather than trapping it.

Out in Rainbow Springs and Rio Vista, and over in Rolling Hills and Rainbow Lake Estates, the building stock is more varied, with more stucco, block, and newer siding. There, the jobs lean toward mildew treatment, elastomeric coatings over hairline stucco cracks, and replacing worn-out builder finishes inside.

Dunnellon summers keep the air heavy with moisture for weeks on end, and from June through September an afternoon storm is the rule on most days of the week. Shaded walls near the water grow mildew, while the walls facing south and west take the sun and slowly fade to a chalky film. October through May is when we push the bulk of Dunnellon's exterior work. When a summer exterior can't wait, the crew gets going at first light and keeps checking dew point and the radar; inside work has no season at all.

For the full list, see our overview of painting services in Dunnellon. Most Dunnellon homeowners start with residential repaints, which split into exterior painting for siding, stucco, and porches and inside work: individual rooms and finish choices or a whole-house interior repaint. In the kitchen we offer kitchen cabinet painting, with vanity and built-in refinishing for bathrooms and other built-ins.

Outside the house, river-town grime calls for soft washing and pressure washing, and we also do deck staining and fence painting and staining. Shops and offices are covered on our page about commercial painting in Dunnellon, and owners picking a palette for an older downtown facade can set up a Dunnellon color consultation.

Expect a crew lead at your Dunnellon property, typically inside 48 hours of your call; there's no salesperson involved. That visit covers measurements, photos of the siding and trim, and moisture checks anywhere the wood or stucco seems questionable. Within about one business day you get an itemized quote listing the surfaces, prep, products, number of coats, and timeline. We won't add to it unless you sign off in writing, and the crew usually arrives one to three weeks after approval.

Once the crew is here, the house is washed, scraped, sanded, and treated for mildew before any color goes on, with rotted boards and fascia swapped out, joints re-caulked, and bare spots primed. When the last coat is dry, you and the crew lead go over the work together and you sign the punch list. Whatever isn't right at that walk is corrected before we wrap up, and a Dunnellon exterior comes with a written workmanship warranty lasting as long as 10 years.
Dunnellon shares our Marion County route with Ocala and Belleview, and we also cross into Levy County to paint in Williston.

faqs.q: Will you take on an older house in the downtown historic district?
faqs.a: Yes. Florida Cracker homes and other older wood houses get extra time for scraping, replacing rot, and priming, and your quote shows each of those steps before the crew starts.

faqs.q: How fast can you schedule an estimate in Dunnellon?
faqs.a: A crew lead usually comes out within 48 hours of your call, and the written quote tends to land in your inbox one business day later.

faqs.q: Is your company licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Florida license, bond, and insurance are current, and every painter on the crew carries workers' comp. If you're an HOA or a business, ask for an insurance certificate made out to your organization before we mobilize.
